item.title: Scottish Government announces new heat pump grants for rural homes
item.description: Households in rural Scotland will be able to claim up to £9,000 towards a heat pump under a scheme announced on Sunday by the net zero secretary, who said the grants would open in January.

item.title: Edinburgh trams extension approved by council
item.description: The City of Edinburgh Council has approved plans to extend the tram line north to Granton, with construction expected to start in 2028.

item.title: New study finds peatland restoration cuts emissions faster than expected
item.description: Researchers measuring restored peat bogs in the Flow Country found carbon emissions fell within three years, faster than models had predicted.
